decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match or be visually compatible to those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (63RA 10 AAmended 07/04/2011)   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The window existing at ground floor shall be removed prior to the occupation of the first floor accommodation.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension
